purpose: Framework-only publication; operator data and source access are deployment-local
included: Application Python modules and static web UI
Generic ingestion, reference indexing and assessment tools
Dependency manifests, deployment templates and CI configuration
excluded: Customer uploads, logs, archives, manifests, receipts and analysis outputs
Catalog/reference SQLite databases and their WAL/SHM files
Downloaded wiki/source payloads, screenshots and raw/compact reference snapshots
Authentication files, cookies, headers, access tokens, SSH keys and credential stores
Production inventory, local server addresses, workstation paths and service logs
Deployment-specific remote inventory/mirroring and one-off recovery scripts
Virtual environments, bytecode caches and generated test/build artifacts

runtime_configuration.no_tenant_default: ATLASSIAN_CLOUD_ID must be supplied to enable authenticated Confluence reads

integration_claims.exemplar: Source-backed local recipes, analysis and script generation; no remote upload/write or certification connector
integration_claims.beacon: Authenticated read-only training API or authorized export import; no bundled records
integration_claims.gpucomms: Public source-session NCCL read/index connector; optional browser tooling is not bundled
integration_claims.nccl_dashboard: Observed-curve catalog read/index connector; target and SOL curves are not measured references
integration_claims.confluence: Operator-configured GET-only evidence discovery and measured-candidate extraction; no bundled corpus
integration_claims.nvbugspro: No authenticated query, synchronization, bug matching or issue creation implementation

deployment_boundary.access_control: Requires operator-managed authenticated TLS reverse proxy; application has no built-in login or customer RBAC
deployment_boundary.storage: Writable persistent data volume; empty startup requires no customer or source data
deployment_boundary.container_validation: Container build and Docker Compose runtime require validation on a Docker-capable host; not executed during local packaging audit

review_scope: This manifest states publication boundaries, not a claim that imported operator evidence is automatically anonymized. Final tracked-file and secret scanning is required before publication.
